payload.title: Recompose the home page
payload.description: Using the patterns: page header (title at top left, site card at top right), the stories as a 7-group, a band, accepted findings as a 1+N list, highly rated findings without images as a text-only grid, conversations, the second band, then found-by-machines. Order and counts to agree with Ryan in the preview. Keep the sentence under the card.
